yeni-mezun-3.title: The Offer Stage
q: What do you look at when weighing your first job offer? How would you decide between several offers?
Learning opportunity: learn, mentor
Team and manager: team, manager
Pay and benefits: salary, pay, benefit
Company and industry: company, industry
Long-term goal: career goal, long-term, long term

At the start of my career I look most at how much I will learn and whether I will have a mentor. The working style of the team and manager I met in the interviews matters a lot to me. I compare salary and benefits with the market, but I do not make them the only criterion. I research how the company and its industry are growing. With several offers, I would score them by which one moves me closest to my long-term career goal and decide on that.
